top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a general method with a mechanistically distinct problem from C-C coupling (amine binding, slow C-N reductive elimination, beta-hydride elimination) solved by transferable ligand design, confirmed independently for four decades and visible in discovery and process chemistry, with a clean two-name Buchwald/Hartwig credit; the Kosugi/Migita precedent is handled by citation wording. P002 is next as a genuine designable principle, but the lack of an approved degrader and the PROTAC versus glue credit cut make it less mature; P004 is mature theory but a unifying framework with contested priority and a recent 2024 prize nearby; P003 still has unsettled in-cell relevance.
